== Biography ==
In November 1729, Robert Glasgow married Rachel Wilson. Robert was constituted an elder of the HOTT Presbyterian Meeting House in 1730.

Robert and Rachel had at least three known children:

* '''[[Glasgow-1144|James Glasgow]]''', born 24 May 1731. He later emigrated to South Carolina.
* '''Ann Taggard Glasgow''', born 15 November 1733. She married [[Shannon-4518|Hugh Shannon]] and raised a family at Ballykeel, Kilwaughter.
* '''[[Glasgow-1501|Rachel Glasgow]]''', born 8 November 1738. No further information about her has yet been identified, and it is possible that she died young.

It has been suggested that Ann and her husband Hugh Shannon may have succeeded James Glasgow on Robert's perpetually renewable lease of the Ballykeel lands, but this remains unproven

== Research Notes ==

Existing child-to-father link assessed from held public evidence; Robert/Rachel’s household has register and independent equity/deed corroboration; Robert’s own ancestry remains unproved.
